title: Rig Relay WriteFile Result v1
description: Schema for a deterministic write_file tool execution result. Contains the full result with mutation evidence fields.

bytes_written.description: Number of bytes written to the file

file_existed.description: Whether the file existed before the write operation

content.description: Full file content after the write operation

before_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the file content before writing

after_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the file content after writing

created_file.description: Whether this operation created a new file

overwrote_existing_file.description: Whether this operation overwrote an existing file

error_kind.description: Structured error classification when status is not success

refusal_reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is refused or blocked

before_bytes.description: File size in bytes before writing

after_bytes.description: File size in bytes after writing
